hero.headline: Welcome to GMF Productions 904
hero.tagline: Music. Fashion. Culture. GMF Productions 904 is an independent record label and premium streetwear brand founded by artist GMF Str3tch.

about.heading: About Joshua Miller
paragraphs: Known to the streets and the industry as GMF Productions, Joshua Miller is a rising force in the rap scene. Representing the authentic sound of the Southside, his music delivers raw lyricism, undeniable grit, and heavy beats.
Built in Jacksonville, Florida, our mission is to inspire ambition, represent authenticity, and create timeless music and fashion that reflects the hustle behind every success.
